title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
summary: Nobel-winning psychologist Daniel Kahneman describes two modes of thought, one quick and intuitive, one slow and deliberate, and the biases and errors in judgment that come from how they interact.
readIf: you want to understand how snap judgments mislead us and how decisions really get made.
skipIf: you want a quick, light read, as it is long and dense.
